author: koapule33
title: Fun Game, But the Bingos Feel a Little Too Convenient Suspicious even!
content:
I’ve given Bingo Blitz 4 stars because, honestly, I really do enjoy playing the game. It’s fun, entertaining, and I find myself coming back to it. However, there are a couple of things that can get pretty frustrating.

The biggest issue is how difficult it can be to progress without spending coins. If you’re someone who doesn’t want to pay to play, it can take forever to build up enough coins to keep playing and actually advance.

What makes it even more frustrating is how often other players seem to magically get Bingo after only one or two numbers have been called. It happens so frequently that it can make you wonder how realistic some of these games actually are. Watching other players get Bingo almost immediately while you’re trying to conserve every coin you have gets pretty annoying.

There have definitely been times where it’s frustrating enough to make me consider deleting the game. But at the same time, I enjoy Bingo Blitz enough that I keep coming back.

Overall, it’s a really fun game, but the combination of extremely fast Bingos and the amount of coins needed to progress makes the experience feel a little absurd sometimes. If the game were a little more balanced for players who don’t spend money, I’d have no problem giving it 5 stars.
